AcceptInvitationRequest.description: The invitation code from the invitation link.

AuditActorResponse.description:
Who acted: a user, by catalog user id and name; the platform, that is a system admin seen from a tenant's log; or the identity
provider. The name is null for a user the catalog does not know.

AuditActorResponseKind.description: The kind of actor of an audit record.

AuditEntryResponse.description:
One record of an audit log: when, the operation (`member.invited`), who acted, what it was done to, and the details the record
keeps (a JSON object, or null). Names are resolved when the log is read: a deleted user reads "Deleted user". It holds no email
address.

AuditTargetResponse.description:
What the action was done to: a tenant with its name at that moment, a user with their name now, or an invitation, which has no
name. A record written before the audit kept targets has none.

AuditTargetResponseKind.description: The kind of target of an audit record.

ChangeMemberRoleRequest.description:
The built-in role to give the member. The role is required: a request without one is refused, so it never falls back to the enum's
first value.

CreateTenantRequest.description: A new tenant, and the email address of its first owner, who is invited once the tenant is ready.

InvitationResponse.description:
A pending invitation: the invited address, its role (Owner, Admin or Member), the catalog user id of the member who invited, and when
it was created and expires. The screen shows an expired invitation from its expiry.

InviteMemberRequest.description:
The address to invite, and the built-in role the invitation gives. The role is required: a request without one is refused, so it
never falls back to the enum's first value.

MemberResponse.description:
A member of the tenant: the user's id, the copy of their email address and name, and their role, Owner, Admin or Member. The email
address and the names are empty when the identity provider deleted the user; the screen shows "Deleted user".

MemberRole.description:
A built-in role: the values of the role of a member and of an invitation, the role filter of the member and the invitation lists,
the role an invitation gives, and the role a member is given.

MeResponse.description:
The signed-in user: the catalog's id, not the identity provider's, the copy of their profile, and whether they are a system admin.
It has no status: a suspended user is refused on every me endpoint (A9), and a deleted user cannot sign in.

MyTenantResponse.description:
A tenant the signed-in user belongs to: an item of their tenant list, the tenant an invitation made them join, and the tenant a
member reads by its id. Its status is active, or suspended when its members cannot enter it.

MyTenantResponseStatus.description: The status of a tenant as its members see it: active, or suspended when they cannot enter it.

code.description: The error's code, such as tenant.not_found. Present when an endpoint refuses the request itself.

errors.description: The messages for each field of a request that failed validation.

traceId.description: The trace id of the request, for the logs.

TenantResponseStatus.description: The status of a tenant: provisioning until its creation ends, then active, suspended or cancelled.

UserResponse.description:
A catalog user: the catalog's id, not the identity provider's, the copy of their profile, their status (active, suspended or
deleted) and whether they are a system admin.

UserResponseStatus.description: The status of a catalog user. A deleted user is one the identity provider no longer knows.
